name: nullchat
description: NullChat — a real-time chat, voice and video platform

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,client -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.dev:https: concurrently -k -n server,client -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev:https -w client"
scripts.desktop: npm run build && npm --prefix desktop install && npm --prefix desktop start
scripts.desktop:win: npm run build && npm --prefix desktop install && npm --prefix desktop run dist:win
scripts.desktop:mac: npm run build && npm --prefix desktop install && npm --prefix desktop run dist:mac
scripts.desktop:linux: npm run build && npm --prefix desktop install && npm --prefix desktop run dist:linux
